name: Gehennas's Conjure Flame Orb summons a Flame Orb that pulses Flame Orb damage
contract: Conjure Flame Orb (2105417) cast but produced nothing: Spell.dbc EFFECT_1 only triggers 2180023 'Cosmetic - Camera Shake Big', a client-only visual with no SUMMON effect, so the orb creature has to be summoned by script on the dummy effect (EFFECT_0). The summoned orb (entry 80644, db.exil.es export) self-casts the periodic pulse 2105418 (Spell.dbc amplitude 275ms), which triggers the Flame Orb damage family (2105419-22, SpellDifficulty.dbc row 2106) on nearby enemies. Gehennas's own cast time for 2105417 is 5000ms (SpellCastTimes.dbc index 6).

steps.label: CONTROL: the hero is in Molten Core
Controlled baseline health so the orb's damage delta is unambiguous
Hero health before Conjure Flame Orb
Gehennas casts Conjure Flame Orb at the hero
Let the 5000ms cast and the orb's first 275ms tick complete
The summoned orb (entry 80644) self-cast its periodic Flame Orb pulse: it was summoned and is ticking
The hero lost health to the Flame Orb damage family (2105419-22), not just a visual cast
